name: bench-2
about: Completed development screens, fixed 2026-11-23. Each trick runs its source task family and two fixed regression sentinels. Baselines are created on demand and shared. Explicit full sweeps only; never a holdout or adoption evidence.

kinds.name: gap
kinds.label: Feature, decisions left out
kinds.about: A request for a small feature in a Python project that leaves out the four decisions the requester has made, and says they haven't thought it through yet. Hidden tests check the four decisions, so only a trick that asks the requester can pass.

kinds.name: no-gap
kinds.label: Feature, decisions stated
kinds.about: The same kind of request, stating all four decisions. The plain prompt usually passes, so a trick can mostly only hurt here.

kinds.name: gap
kinds.label: Data question, fact left out
kinds.about: A request for one rate from a table, for a meeting, that leaves out which group or from which month the requester means. Only a trick that asks the requester can pass.

kinds.name: no-gap
kinds.label: Data question, fact stated
kinds.about: The same kind of request with that fact stated.

kinds.name: belief-wrong
kinds.label: Analysis, wrong belief
kinds.about: Customer, order or delivery data, and a request that states a belief about what drives an outcome; the belief is wrong, and the report must name the real cause.

kinds.name: belief-right
kinds.label: Analysis, right belief
kinds.about: The same, where the stated belief is right.

kinds.name: more
kinds.label: Bug report, more failures
kinds.about: A bug report about one CSV file that stops a Python import program, where two other files in the project also stop it, each for a different reason. The hidden check imports new files with all three problems.

kinds.name: only
kinds.label: Bug report, one failure
kinds.about: The same kind of report, where the reported file is the only one that fails.
